name: Lens
summary: A round search button in a site header that springs open into a full search field
about: A shop header with a small round search button. Click it and the circle stretches into a pill on a spring, the logo and links slide aside, and the placeholder types product ideas. Suggestions slide in with matches highlighted, a highlight pill glides between them, and results appear in the page below.
how: Click or tap the magnifier (it glints on hover) and the field springs open with the cursor inside
Type to see matching products with the matching letters highlighted; Up and Down arrows move the highlight
Press Enter or click a suggestion to search; the magnifier scans while results load
Results slide into the page with a count, or a tip if nothing matched
Press the × to clear the text, and again, Escape or click outside to close it
